title: The Still Traveler
text: In the dark between places, a lantern burns, and under it a traveler sits very still, hooded, with a pack exactly like yours, down to the patch and the stain. It does not move. Its hood is turned toward you.

options.label: The Leader speaks to it, to learn why it carries their pack.

outcomes.text: It is the Leader, a little older. It says one thing, and it is worth the trip.
It is the Leader, a little older, and it is not well.

options.label: Swap packs with it, and see what the road has yet to give you.

outcomes.text: Its pack holds things you have not found yet, and some things you do not want to find.

options.label: The Leader puts out its lantern, so it watches no longer.

outcomes.text: It goes out. So does the traveler. The dark is darker, and you understand it a little better.
